scope: Requirements-to-evidence planning; award level is not established by passing these checks.

requirements.requirement: Camera acquisition, frame buffering and continuous corrected display
requirements.remaining: Long-run stability, end-to-end input-to-display latency and higher-resolution modes

requirements.requirement: Real calibrated radial/tangential model and bilinear resampling
requirements.remaining: Physical edge straightness did not improve in one left-side pose; independent multi-pose optical validation. Nonzero tangential RTL coverage is provided separately by synthetic gamma-frame regression.

requirements.requirement: External host or IMU input for arbitrary-angle dynamic correction
requirements.remaining: Physical camera rotation demonstration and full-angle optical acceptance
Pipeline full routed multi-corner timing, actual controller throughput and resource/thermal comparison

requirements.requirement: Adaptive Gamma or histogram enhancement for strong/low light
requirements.remaining: Independent matched real strong/low-light image comparisons; quantitative contrast, clipping, noise and optical quality; physical dimming-mode acceptance

requirements.requirement: MTF50/SFR, straightness, edge stretching/discontinuity quality evaluation
requirements.remaining: Suitable slanted-edge target, documented measurement method, same-source raw/corrected captures at center and edges; no final optical quality claim

requirements.requirement: Realtime performance, with 1080p30/60 given as examples; measured hardware end-to-end latency
requirements.remaining: Camera measured about 22.79fps; remaining capture/bank scheduling and processing cost, higher-resolution camera/DDR/HDMI modes and hardware end-to-end latency. HDMI about 60Hz includes repeated frames.

requirements.requirement: Modular source, complete constraints, CDC/memory ownership, performance report and live final demonstration
requirements.remaining: Final reproducible release, repeated cold boots, bounded thermal acceptance and demo under physical camera/test-card changes
